contract_readiness.requirement: Exactly nine frozen persistent Evaluation fields; no hidden authority or parallel record.
Only the canonical published TrainingAttempt is accepted; retain its submitted analysis and single task/objective/target.
Exact TrainingAttempt/context/boundary/reference type gates precede canonical snapshot reconstruction; duck typing cannot bypass validation.
No mutation of TrainingAttempt, user_analysis, TrainingContext or KnowledgeBoundary; output stores no input object alias.
Formal authority uses submission Stage, learned CORE allowed concepts, canonical Error->Concept and Error->Skill mappings only.
Later learning, caller-source changes and later Learning Map revisions cannot expand a saved attempt authority.
Error Stage ceiling is S1 only / S1-S2 / S1-S3 for attempt Stage S1 / S2 / S3.
Require nonempty intersection of Error mapped concepts, historical learned concepts and canonical Stage allowed CORE concepts.
primary_error is str|None with cardinality zero or one; no alternate formal error field or parameter.
contributors is tuple[str,...] with zero, one or two IDs.
Contributors are unique and exclude primary_error.
abstain requires no primary/contributors; LOW requires abstain; correct/no-error may remain non-abstaining.
Derive skill_signal from primary error, otherwise first contributor, otherwise Stage primary Skill, without override.
No later market movement, future candle, trade result, realized P/L or prediction-result API input.
what_was_correct is immutable tuple[str,...], with canonical nonempty text members.
contributors is immutable tuple[str,...] of canonical approved Error IDs.
evaluation_confidence is exactly canonical HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW.
abstain has exact bool type; reject integers, strings, truthy objects and other bool-like substitutes.
Base-str values and immutable tuples close mutable aliases using Evaluation-local validation only.
No change needed to shared contracts, Training, Learning Map, LearningState, Review or Study Entry.

public_constructor_strategy.record: One Evaluation record: frozen, slotted dataclass with init disabled and a public __new__ that always raises TypeError. Exactly the nine shared dataclass fields and slots; no instance __dict__, hidden authority field, token field, or parallel type.
public_constructor_strategy.public_api: Export only Evaluation and create_evaluation. All public Evaluation(...) calls, with no arguments, nine field arguments, or malformed combinations, are rejected. dataclasses.replace cannot construct a replacement through the blocked constructor.
public_constructor_strategy.factory: Only create_evaluation validates and builds a record. Complete all Training, boundary, text, Error, cardinality, abstain, confidence and skill checks before its private allocation via object.__new__(Evaluation) and assignment of nine validated immutable fields. No caller allocation/validation token, unchecked public builder, skill_signal, target, objective, boundary, or mapping override.
public_constructor_strategy.training_validation: Require exact published TrainingAttempt, TrainingContext, KnowledgeBoundary and LearningMapReference types before any reconstruction. Normalize string subclasses with the base str operation before comparisons; reject nonstrings and equality spoofs. Validate canonical containers, CORE confidence pairs and exact reference scalar values; reject mismatched Stage, expanded allowed/learned sets, future/unapproved concepts and constructor-invalid tampering. Reconstruct through published KnowledgeBoundary, TrainingContext and TrainingAttempt constructors without editing any source, preserving original ID/timestamp/analysis and initial submission invariants.
public_constructor_strategy.historical_authority: Consume only the canonicalized attempt Stage and stored learned concepts. Copy no current LearningState or later Learning Map. All 19 Error->Stage/Concept/Skill mappings and three Stage->primary Skill mappings are minimal immutable compatibility tuples from the frozen Learning Map; no concept definitions or mutable mapping inputs.
public_constructor_strategy.text_and_prose: Copy collections to tuples; normalize every stored str subclass to base str and reject empty/whitespace-only or nonstring values. Reject any canonical approved Error-ID token carried in primary_issue or hint before returning; include punctuation, multi-token and subclass cases. Prose is evaluator-supplied diagnostic content scoped to this attempt; no NLP classifier or invented technical-analysis detection criteria.
public_constructor_strategy.boundary_limit: The review covers supported public constructors and factories and malformed or tampered values that violate canonical invariants. Python low-level object allocation or reflection is not an additional supported construction API. No persistent provenance store is introduced.
public_constructor_strategy.future_verification: Constructor and factory regression cases must execute in tests/evaluation/test_evaluation.py in the first implementation cycle; this PRE creates no candidate and executes no Evaluation tests.
